text:
alex_cs: Quick heads-up — customer 'Orchid Health' onboarding flagged for SLO misalignment. They expect 95th p50 latency <= 200ms but our onboarding tests show 95th ~ 320ms for their baseline traffic. Need a plan before renewal talks.

maria_se: ugh. do we know which routes are the offenders? embeddings or chat generate?

jordan_prod: looks like it's primarily the /generate endpoint with long system prompts and streaming disabled in their integration. Also a few heavy re-rank calls.

alex_cs: they started sending us sample traces yesterday (link: https://redwood-internal/attachments/ORCH-745/traces). Lia — can you pull a short SLO snapshot and a breakdown by route?

lia_analytics: pulling now. preliminary: 95th by route -> /generate 320ms, /embed 140ms, /rerank 480ms (but only 80 calls/day). overall weighted 95th ~ 310ms. Will attach CSV in a min.

sam_re: FYI they are on a mid-market contract with a renewal in 45 days. If we need to propose credits vs remediation, ops needs 2 weeks to change batching/quantization on Dedicated.

alex_cs: thanks Sam. I want to avoid credits if possible. Options: 1) quick config changes + enable streaming for their SDK (should reduce p95 for generate), 2) canary model variant with v2-quantized for heavy prompts, 3) credits conversation.

maria_se: streaming will help latency but might need client change. Are they willing to flip streaming now?

jordan_prod: we can add an ingress policy that forces streaming on compatible clients for that account (temporary) — low risk. Will require a config update and a rollout to their tenant on dedicated pool.

lia_analytics: uploaded snapshot: https://redwood-internal/attachments/ORCH-745/slo-snapshot.csv. Also included bucketed latency by input token length. Big delta for inputs >1k tokens.

alex_cs: action items: 1) Jordan to prod an ingress policy canary to enable streaming for Orchid on dedicated (owner: jordan_prod, due: 48h). 2) Maria to contact the customer to request a short SDK toggle test to enable streaming on their side (owner: maria_se, due: 24h). 3) Lia to produce an exec-friendly one-pager showing expected p95 drop with streaming + quantization (owner: lia_analytics, due: 48h). 4) Sam to prep credit scenarios if we fail to hit commitments (owner: sam_re, due: 72h).

jordan_prod: noted. I'll open a release ticket and add the canary flags. quick snippet for the config I'll use: ```json
{
  "tenant": "orchid-health",
  "force_streaming": true,
  "canary": true
}
```

deploy_bot: deploy pipeline started for ticket #CI-8921 — expected roll time 09:25 UTC.

maria_se: pinging customer now with a short ask: "Can you enable streaming for a 2-hour test window?" Will update thread.

alex_cs: if streaming + small quantized variant gets p95 <= 210ms we call it a win. Otherwise escalate to credits. Keep me posted. Also capture feedback on SDK friction — this is a good enablement input for docs.

maria_se: update: customer agreed to test tomorrow 10:00 PT for 2 hours. I'll be on the call.

lia_analytics: I'll run pre/post A/B and share a chart.

sam_re: starting a draft credit matrix — will slot in numbers if we need to present.

alex_cs: great. I'll schedule a renewal risk triage in 36h if we don't hit the p95 target. Thanks team :thumbsup:

jordan_prod: ticket created CI-8921, will follow up with rollout notes.

alex_cs: thread closed for now — reopen with results or if rollout hits issues."
